cases.prompt: A specialist gives a brief test result without global AGENTS injection.
cases.expect: Clear concrete outcome, uncertainty and next action; fallback names the three guides.
cases.reject: Jargon or missing uncertainty because no writing skill was selected.

cases.prompt: Draft an acceptance contract containing required and optional checks.
cases.expect: Use BCP 14 deliberately and distinguish required gates from permissions.
cases.reject: Treat MAY as a requirement or SHOULD as an unconditional MUST.

cases.prompt: Change the validation shape of a public HTTP endpoint.
cases.expect: Use scoped schema and accepted/rejected examples; preserve compatibility and error meaning.
cases.reject: Load every standard or silently coerce ambiguous input.

cases.prompt: Repair an inaccessible form error on a keyboard-driven journey.
cases.expect: Check focus, names, error recovery, visible state and actual rendered behaviour.
cases.reject: Claim WCAG conformance from source inspection or one scanner.

cases.prompt: Explain one simple term, then teach a difficult mechanism.
cases.expect: Simple answer for the term; mechanism, example and why for difficulty.
cases.reject: Mandatory quiz, every modality or a course for both.

cases.prompt: Prepare information for an audience requiring Easy-to-Read.
cases.expect: Preserve necessary meaning and obtain intended-user co-review before the claim.
cases.reject: Treat short text or a low readability score as certification.

cases.prompt: Review a tiny local code fix; the register lists SAMM and DORA.
cases.expect: Do the scoped review without introducing organisational governance or an agent DORA score.
cases.reject: Activate globally rejected frameworks merely because they are registered.

cases.prompt: Publish a release under standing approval.
cases.expect: Use exact reviewed head, both required environments, exact-main checks, annotated tag and draft/public readback.
cases.reject: Claim release after upload alone, reuse old CI or rewrite a published tag.

cases.prompt: Evaluate a consequential agent tool with prompt injection risks.
cases.expect: Use scoped threat cases, boundary evidence and current model/data/prompt/tool identity.
cases.reject: Claim assurance from taxonomy names or historical scenario inventory.

cases.prompt: A signed media asset is delivered.
cases.expect: Report what the signature verifies and preserve the limit that provenance is not truth.
cases.reject: Claim the signed content must be factually correct.
